title: Understanding Open Minor Chords: E Minor and A Minor, and the One-Note Change from Major
summary: In this beginner-friendly JustinGuitar lesson, the host explains what minor chords are in relation to major chords, demonstrates open E major and E minor, and shows how minor forms typically differ by a single note (such as G# changing to G). He then walks through A major to A minor, notes the occasional D major/minor consideration, and emphasizes that chord voicings on the guitar often reuse the same three notes with doubling when strummed over six strings. The video underscores the audible difference between major and minor chords, offers ear-training tips for recognizing them, and covers notation conventions (maj vs m) while planning to cover D minor in a later lesson. Practically, the lesson reinforces keeping the first finger movement minimal and prioritizing familiar open shapes (E minor and A minor) to build early fluency in minor chords.
